role: On-device regex shortcut for voice turns: a hand-authored list of 14 patterns whose handlers answer common factual questions (recovery, RHR, HRV, sleep, last workout, weight, max HR, LTHR, etc.) from the session archive and settings without calling an LLM.
types: DeterministicIntent: enum (@MainActor) — pattern catalog + matcher + spoken-reply helpers
DeterministicIntent.MatchContext: struct — now, SessionArchive, UserSettings handed to handlers
DeterministicIntent.Pattern: struct — id, regex triggers, handler closure
toplevel: static let patterns (110-399) defines 14 Pattern handlers as closures: recovery_score_today (todaysOvernightEntry → recoveryScore×10 → RecoveryScoreCalculator.displayScore + ScoreVerdict(score:).localizedWord; nil when no reliable overnight or score), resting_hr_today (archive.retrieveLightweightOrLog(entry) → vitalsSnapshot.restingHeartRate; a read failure is logged and falls through to the LLM), hrv_rmssd_today (entry.meanRMSSD), sleep_duration_last_night (sleepSnapshot.nightSleepMinutes + measuredSleepEfficiency when non-nil), last_workout_summary (first .workout entry in newest-first archive.entries; endDate-date minutes; 0/no endDate → day only), trained_recently ('yesterday' substring picks dayStart(isYesterday:); sums the durations of every .workout that day; always returns a string, 'No workout recorded…' when none), score_breakdown_today (session.scoreBreakdown.factors localized label + rounded score, list-formatted, plus ScoreVerdict.safeDisplayScore(compositeScore)), sleep_stages_last_night (deep/REM/stages/breakdown triggers — light sleep is not matched; totalSleepIncludingNapMinutes; deep/REM minutes or 'No sleep stage data' when either is nil), body_weight (settings.bodyWeightKg, imperial when UnitsPreferenceStore.current.resolved == .imperial), max_hr and lthr (settings value, nil below MaxHeartRate.minimumUserEntered), sleep_latency (sleepSnapshot.sleepLatencyMinutes), sleep_efficiency (measuredSleepEfficiency or a 'wasn't measured' sentence), total_session_count (counts of all / .workout / .overnight entries; always answers). Replies use String(localized:bundle: LanguageManager.appBundle). Session reads use retrieveLightweightOrLog. Apostrophe classes accept ' and ’ and an omitted apostrophe ('whats'). Reads archive:SessionArchive.entries, archive:SessionArchive.retrieveLightweight, ud:UnitsPreferenceStore (units preference), mem:UserSettings fields.

flags.text: DeterministicIntentTests only exercise matching against an empty archive and dayStart; no test seeds an archive to check any handler's spoken numbers (e.g. the ×10 recovery scaling).

docs/VOICE_AND_TOOL_USE.md:149-150 says each pattern maps 1:1 to a fact-catalog read; no handler touches FactResolverRegistry (the header now says so) — they re-read SessionArchive/UserSettings directly, so the voice path duplicates catalog logic (e.g. 0-10 to 0-100 score conversion also in AppFactResolver+Live.swift:193) and can drift from what the LLM tools report.
docs/FLOWCHART.md:1434 says a hit emits 'telemetry: deterministic_hit'; no such event exists in Swift (grep deterministic_hit) - servedDeterministically only debugLogs.

units.does: Returns the cached compiled regexes for this pattern via compiledTriggers(forPatternID:triggers:).

Returns the cached [NSRegularExpression] for a pattern id, compiling each trigger case-insensitively and caching on first use; a trigger that fails to compile is dropped and logged (warning) with the pattern id and error.

branches.effect: returns cached regexes; otherwise compiles, stores and returns

units.does: Normalizes the utterance, finds the first pattern whose any trigger matches, runs its handler and returns the reply; returns nil (send to LLM) when empty, no match, or handler returned nil.
calls: closure:Pattern.handler — the 14 handler closures in DeterministicIntent.patterns
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite via UnitsPreferenceStore.current, legacy standard-suite fallback; body_weight handler)

branches.cond: matched handler returned nil (data not ready)
branches.effect: logs 'match=<id> but no data' and returns nil; otherwise logs 'served' and returns the answer

units.does: True when any compiled trigger of the pattern finds a match anywhere in the full normalized string.
Lowercases, trims whitespace/newlines, then trims '.?!,' from both edges.
Start of the current day for now, or start of the previous calendar day when isYesterday, using calendar.date(byAdding:.day,-1) (DST-safe).

branches.effect: ?? falls back to today's start (not reachable for Gregorian input); otherwise the previous day's start

units.does: Returns the newest reliable (isReliableForHRVAggregates) overnight archive entry whose midpoint (date + (endDate??date - date)/2) lies within the local day containing now; nil if none.

branches.effect: ?? uses entry.date → duration 0, midpoint = start date; an open session is matched by its start day

units.does: Spoken day label: RelativeDateTimeFormatter named/full ('today', 'yesterday', '3 days ago') for <14 days, else a localized 'MMMMd' date.

branches.effect: ?? Int.max → falls to the absolute date format
relative phrase with -max(0,days) (future dates say 'today'); otherwise MMMMd date

units.does: Formats minutes as a full spelled-out duration ('7 hours, 12 minutes') in the app locale; negative input clamped to 0.

branches.effect: allowed units hour+minute; else minute only

units.does: Formats body weight with the long unit name: whole pounds when imperial, one-decimal kilograms otherwise.
Reply for trained_recently: 'Yes — you logged a workout.' when minutes <= 0, else 'Yes — you trained for <spoken duration>.'

branches.effect: returns the duration-less sentence; otherwise the duration sentence
